fields.description: ISS-2026-00636 / MOM 3.6 -- not reqd: a Custom Style request (custom_requested_style set instead) has no real catalog item behind it. Exactly one of item/custom_requested_style must be set -- enforced in sales.inquiry_api._create_inquiry, not here.
fields.label: Item

fields.description: ISS-2026-00636 / MOM 3.6 -- WhatsApp's "Custom Style" option: a dealer describes a design that isn't in the item master at all, free text, rather than this app inventing a placeholder Item. Set instead of `item`, never alongside it.
fields.label: Requested Style (Custom)

fields.description: Client request, 2 Nov 2026 -- the dealer portal's own "Boxes" field value when entered together with pieces (entered_qty/entered_uom below then hold the Pcs side). Null whenever the dealer entered only boxes.
fields.label: Entered Boxes

fields.description: Client request, 2 Nov 2026 -- the qty/unit the dealer actually entered, when it wasn't Box. `qty` itself always stays in boxes; these are display-only.
fields.label: Entered Qty
Entered UOM
fields.options:
Box
Pcs
Sqft
Sqm
Kg
Gram

fields.description: ISS-2026-00678 -- the dealer explicitly asked for this against damaged/insurance-claim bay stock. Carries through to Quotation Item/Sales Order Item (custom_damaged_stock) so picking routes to the Damages Bay.
fields.label: Damaged Stock

fields.description: ISS-2026-00712 -- the dealer's own batch choice at enquiry time, carried onto the resulting Sales Order line if/when this converts. Left unset ("Auto"), order_api._resolve_delivery_picks draws whichever batch(es) are on hand, largest lot first.
fields.label: Preferred Batch

fields.description: BRD D.3 -- 12 Nov 2026 rebuild: split out from the Inquiry's own `status` (now workflow-only) once one Inquiry could hold items with genuinely different stock positions at once. Computed at create_inquiry time from this item's real stock, same check the WhatsApp/portal reply already made -- not re-derived live on every read.
fields.label: Availability
fields.options:
Open
Available
Partially Available
Out of Stock
Pre-order Required

fields.description: BRD D.3 -- client request, 12 Nov 2026. Set when the dealer already has another still-open inquiry item for the same item+damaged_stock within the last 24 hours (sales.utils.recent_inquiry_for) -- a visible record for Pacific staff, separate from the same-moment `duplicateOf` hint create_inquiry's own response carries.
fields.label: Duplicate Flag
